nodes.label: .`getMe carries theme, timeZone and timeZoneIsFallback, null until saved`()
.`AC-179 PATCH theme saves it and answers the preferences`()
.`AC-184 PATCH timeZone saves it and clears the fallback flag`()
.`PATCH with an empty body answers the current preferences`()
.`AC-186 PATCH timeZone null or empty is time-zone-required and keeps the zone`()
.`PATCH unknown timeZone is unknown-time-zone and keeps the zone`()
.`AC-182 PATCH unknown theme is unknown-theme and keeps the theme`()
.`a refused timezone leaves a valid theme in the same request unsaved`()
.`PATCH theme for an Owner with no saved zone answers timeZone null and not a fallback, like GET me`()
.`PATCH with an unknown key is 400 validation-failed and changes nothing`()
.`PATCH without the CSRF header is 403 and without a session 401`()
.`AC-183 detected zone is saved when unset and a later one changes nothing`()
.`AC-183 null or unknown detected zone saves UTC as the fallback`()
.`detected zone save is 403 without CSRF and 401 without a session`()
.`a background-marked detected zone save does not bump session activity`()
.`listTimeZones answers the sorted whole list and 401 without a session`()
